thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: eu-west-serving - error_rate spikes >5% sustained for 3m. Severity: P2. Autorefresh: https://grafana.redwood/d/eu-west/serving

incident-bot: Triggered by rule: serving_errors__5m > 0.05 && requests_5m > 1000. Alerting policy: page-on-call

maria: taking this. paging oncall and starting triage. anyone on eu-west?

alex: I'm in eu-west. pulling up request logs + tailing nginx-frontend.

jon: graph looks like a traffic shift at 12:17 UTC — spikes in 2 AZs but not all. routing hints show increased retries to replica-a.

maria: possible degraded instance group causing retries -> success rate drop. alex can you flip traffic to standby region for impacted route? run failover plan step 1.

alex: running failover now: ``/ops/runbook failover --route serving-eu --to eu-central-standby``. will post status.

incident-bot: Failover job started (job_id=ff12). ETA ~90s.

priya: FYI customer-reports queue got 3 messages about slow responses, but no high-visibility outages yet. recommend setting badge to "customer-impact:potential" until we know.

kevin: I see a noisy alert churning: synthetic-check-eu is firing alongside real errors. that synthetic job restarted at 12:15 and created a false-positive spike.

maria: good catch. alex pause synthetic canaries in eu-west for now. we want to avoid alert noise during mitigation.

alex: paused synthetic-check-eu (job 982). failover completed, traffic shifted to eu-central-standby, error_rate falling back to baseline.

jon: post-failover metrics: error_rate now 1.2% (was 6.8%), p95 latency stable. rolling retries down. looks good.

maria: great. immediate mitigation done. next: short post-incident tune: 1) mute synthetic-check-eu alert on restarts; 2) add 2-min smoothing to serving_errors rule to avoid 1m blips; 3) add multi-region failover dashboard with traffic shift panel and per-AZ heatmap; 4) add runbook step to automatically pause canaries during planned restarts. owners?

jon: I can own the Grafana dashboard + panel (jon -> grafana/dashboards/multi-region-health).

kevin: I'll handle the alert rule tweak and add 2-min window and doc the reason.

priya: I'll update the runbook with new pause-canary step and customer-communication template.

alex: I'll verify the synthetic-job retry behavior and add idempotency to the startup so restarts don't trigger alerts.

maria: assign owners in incident tracker. we should also add a new failover monitor alert: "regional_traffic_shift > 25% sustained 5m" to detect gradual shifts that don't spike errors immediately.

incident-bot: Action items recorded: IJ-4523 (mute-synthetic), IJ-4524 (alert-tuning), IJ-4525 (dashboard), IJ-4526 (runbook).

maria: follow-up meeting 30m to finalize tuning and decide if thresholds change permanently. for now, keep the synthetic paused and monitors on watch. thanks all :thumbsup:
__note: This document is a single Slack thread string; messages are chronological and prefixed with sender names as required.
